purpose: Frozen 11-scene validation measurement of full graph-option progress, after train-pilot fidelity gates pass.
limits: Balanced diagnostic subset: 66 routes in 11 unseen scenes, one simulator seed. No learning or full-benchmark improvement claim. STOP gates and final-decision budget preserved; distances analysis-only.

analysis.primary: Best admissible non-STOP full-option goal progress minus actually selected ghost; learned and forced STOP states excluded
controls: primitive count no greater than selected
movement path no longer than selected
